messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take the missed dose if it is within 4 days after the missed dose"
set: ["take the missed dose if it is within 4 days after the missed dose", "Skip the missed dose", "if you take Horizant, skip the missed dose", "administer as soon as possible within 5 days after the missed dose", "if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose", "skip the missed dose if it has been more than 4 days since your last dose", "if a dose is missed, the missed dose should be skipped", "If you have missed the dose for the whole day, skip it", "do not take the missed dose if you miss a dose of the tablets", "take the missed dose as soon as you remember", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at usual time", "do not take a missed dose during the day", "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed", "continue your regular dosing schedule after skipping the missed dose", "skip missed dose if almost evening", "return to regular schedule after missed dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
